title: confed init result
description: The `result` of `confed init --json`. Nothing is written until the credentials have been verified against the server, so a failed init leaves the directory untouched.

id.description: Numeric space id, when the server exposes one.

credential_store.description: Where the token ended up. `sqlite` means .session.db (mode 0600) because no OS keyring was available.

created.description: Files init created in this directory.

gitignore_added.description: Lines appended to .gitignore. Empty when they were already there.
